text:
sara: Quick heads-up — we need to lock the launch cutlist by EOD. Current candidate cuts: tenant SSO, embeddings caching, dedicated autoscale burst, and in-console evals. I want a recommendation: what keeps us on our latency/cost SLAs while preserving the demoable surface?

alex: my gut — drop tenant SSO for MVP, keep a single-tenant flow. SSO adds ~3 weeks of infra/security lift. :grimacing:

ravi: embeddings cache is low-effort if we ship a basic LRU prefix cache (we can disable for high-card requests). Saves ~20-30% tokens for search flows. That might actually reduce cost more than cutting SSO.

maggie: for the demo, SSO makes enterprise feel real. If we cut SSO, UX needs a clear note for pilots. Also cutting in-console evals hurts our sales narrative (shows quality regression checks).

ben: tradeoff view: prioritize what reduces operational risk and unit cost. If embeddings cache gives measurable cost wins and low risk, prefer that over SSO. But confirm engineering effort.

alex: effort: SSO ~3w (sec review + infra), embeddings cache MVP ~5d + 1d ops. Autoscale burst: largely config, but we need safe fallbacks (policy + tests) ~1w. In-console evals ~2w (frontend + baseline datasets).

sara: ok, so ranking by impact/effort: 1) embeddings cache (high impact / low effort), 2) autoscale config (medium effort), 3) in-console evals (sales impact), 4) tenant SSO (high effort). Proposal: ship embeddings cache and autoscale config in MVP, move in-console evals to v1, defer tenant SSO to pilot phase.

ravi: +1. Need a small rollout plan: enable cache for 10% canary, monitor token delta and latency. If token delta >= 15% and no latency regress, ramp.

maggie: if we move evals to v1, ask sales to adjust pitch deck. I'll update marketing copy and add a slide about "pilot evals available".

alex: depends on timeline — can we still hit the milestone if we take embeddings + autoscale? current schedule shows 2-week QA window; embedding MVP fits.

sara: timeline sanity check: current milestone freeze = 1727400000 (two weeks). If we accept this cutlist, engineering sign-off by tomorrow noon? Need explicit ack to freeze scope.

ben: agree. Engineering sign-off by tomorrow noon. Sales/UX to prepare mitigation comms.

alex: signing off for eng — will add the canary plan and tests to the PR template.

ravi: will own cache implementation + metrics.

maggie: will update decks + release notes.

sara: thanks. I'll post final cutlist and ship checklist after noon.

deploy-bot: Reminder: milestone freeze scheduled in 4 days. See <https://redwood-internal/boards/launch-1727400000>

ben: one caveat — if canary shows higher latency, we fallback to disabling cache per-policy. Make sure that fallback is automated.

alex: noted. adding auto-disable on 99p latency spike to the runbook.

sara: action items: (1) alex + ravi: canary plan + PRs by EOD tomorrow, (2) maggie: sales comms + deck update, (3) ben: confirm launch criteria—cost delta target + latency SLO. Will reconvene after signoffs.

maggie: acked.

ravi: acked.

alex: acked.

ben: acked.

sara: closing thread when I post the official cutlist. Thanks all. :tada:
